programme.title: Nile: the final river – Mountains of the Moon | E01
programme.desc: Researchers present extraordinary places located in the Nile Delta. They visit, among others: Lake Victoria and the Semien Mountains to look at the local fauna and flora. Documentarians go on a journey through areas related to the Upper Nile. They present the flora of the Rwenzori mountain range and observe the yellow-sided nectaries living in this region. They also visit the Nyungwe Forest National Park, which is inhabited by numerous representatives of primates, including: chimpanzees and Angolan gerees. They also stop at Lake Victoria to capture the extraordinary chironomid mating dance. Austria. 2014. documentary film

programme.title: Nile: the final river – On wild waters | E02
programme.desc: Researchers present extraordinary places located in the Nile Delta. They visit, among others: Lake Victoria and the Semien Mountains to look at the local fauna and flora. The Victoria Nile creates foamy rapids and waterfalls. In South Sudan, Africa's largest wetland area is being created - the Sudd, which is inhabited by, among others, antelopes, great herons and shoebills. From its source in East Africa to the deserts of Sudan, the Nile flows through a wide strip of the wildest nature. Hippos and crocodiles live here. Over 400 species of birds breed and hunt along the Victoria Nile, including: African razorbills and white-bellied storks. During the dry season, giant elephants search for water in grassy areas. North of the Nile, the hilly savanna is noteworthy - the home of a rare species of antelope: the kobus. Austria. 2014. documentary film

programme.title: Nile: the ultimate river – Life in the desert | E03
programme.desc: Researchers present extraordinary places located in the Nile Delta. They visit, among others: Lake Victoria and the Semien Mountains to look at the local fauna and flora. The Abyssinian Plateau is the cradle of the Blue Nile. Without its waters, the great river would evaporate in the desert before reaching the sea. The Blue Nile flows from Lake Tana in Ethiopia, where the Semien Mountains are located. With steep slopes in the warm rays of the sun and strong updrafts - it is a paradise for birds of prey. The slopes and peaks of the Semien Mountains are home to thousands of vultures. The upper parts of the Blue Nile are inhabited by rare species, such as geladas, close relatives of baboons, and Abyssinian ibexes. Austria. 2014. documentary film

programme.desc: A story about the evolution of animals over time. The creators of the series wonder how people can be inspired by the various features and abilities of wild creatures. programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E03
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. With the melting of ice and global warming, a completely new era in Earth's history begins. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan set out to search for the land that connected Britain with the Old Continent before the end of the Ice Age. Steve goes deep beneath the waves, and Michaela investigates the course of the natural disaster that formed the North Sea and divided Europe. The disaster was a catalyst for the further development of the first people who began to create boats. In the Arctic, Michaela works with the British Antarctic Survey drilling for ice cores. The material obtained in this way will reveal how the world's climate is changing. It turns out that global warming may create ideal conditions for the start of a new ice age. Steve will test whether people would cope if the Earth were plunged into eternal frost again. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: 30 for 30: Bullies of Baltimore
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: Baby Animals: Raising Babies (S1 E7). Documentary about nature. USA, 2015. S1, Ep7
programme.desc: 2015 г. Год: 2015. Страна: JAV. Год: 2015. S1, Ep7 «Baby Animals»…Raising Babies. Meet the world's tiniest baby animals and see how they travel the road from birth to adolescence and adulthood. From building strong family ties to learning how to escape predators, these little creatures explore the world around themArctic foxes, sea otters, tamarin monkeys and red pandas are just some of the tiniest, cutest creatures featured in Baby Animals. With their big eyes and wobbly first steps, nature's newbies are irresistible. Watch how animals nurture their young as infant elephants, baby bison and rambunctious rhinos all eat, sleep and play their way to adulthood in their respective natural habitats. Cuddly, clumsy and full of mischief, the babies of the animal kingdom certainly make up the wildest daycare you've ever seen. Find out how it all happens

programme.title: Secret Life Of the Tasmanian Devil: Young Devils (S1 E2). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2016. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2016 г. Год: 2016. Страна: JAV. Год: 2016. S1, Ep2 «Secret Life of the Tasmanian Devil»…Tasmanian Devils might have the most infamous reputations of any of the country's marsupials, but these spirited scrappers also have another side. They're committed parents and heroic defenders of their pouch-reared youngIn this documentary series we explore one of Australia's most intriguing creatures: the Tasmanian devil. Made infamous by the eponymous character in the Warner Bros animated series, Looney Tunes, we reveal the life of these pint-sized, carnivorous marsupials as never seen before. They can be aggressive little animals, ferociously fending off potential predators, as well as battling each other for superiority, but we also showcase their dedication as parents and love for their family members. Once native to mainland Australia, Tasmanian devils are now only found on the island of Tasmania, and there is a huge conservationist effort to ensure the species does not see extinction. The series is filmed at the Devil Ark preservation project in New South WalesDirector: Ashley DaviesCast: Virge Gilchrist

programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2020. S1, Ep6 «Mysteries Of the Mekong»…Although the Mekong runs down Thailand's far eastern border, the influence of the river's basin reaches across nearly half the country. The east of Thailand is characterized by a complex network of the Mekong's tributaries. These waterways are the foundation of life for many different ecosystems; from extensive rice fields to large pockets of tropical rainforestTravel one of the mightiest waterways in the world as this journey along the Mekong River takes us across a cornucopia of diverse landscapes starting from its source high up in the Tibetan Plateau in China, We follow the meandering route through Laos and its western border with Thailand, one of the most pristine natural habitats on the planet dominated by abundant forests full of enchanting flora and fauna and a complex river system that feeds into the Mekong. programme.title: Expedition Europa
programme.desc: The peregrine falcon circles elegantly over the Elbe Sandstone Mountains (above). In terms of geological history, this natural landscape is still relatively young. The striking rock formations were formed by the Elbe, which worked its way through the sedimentary rocks deposited by a primeval ocean. The Alps, on the other hand, were formed through a different geological process. High peaks such as the Matterhorn and Zugspitze were folded as a result of the collision of the African and European tectonic plates. Colin Devey also visits Vesuvius in Italy. The ruins of Pompeii bear witness to the destructive forces that lie deep underground.

programme.title: The water world of Komodo

programme.title: CÚ ĐẤM THÉP - IRON KUNG FU FIST
programme.desc: Võ sư Liang Kun rút lui khỏi giang hồ để bảo vệ người phụ nữ anh yêu, nhưng sự vắng mặt của anh đã dẫn đến cái chết bi thảm của cô. Nhận ra mình không thể thoát khỏi số phận được nữa, anh quay trở lại thế giới võ thuật. Với sự giúp đỡ của tộc trưởng ăn xin Su Can, Liang Kun chiến đấu vượt qua những kẻ thù tàn nhẫn để trả thù cho cô.

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!

programme.title: ĐẶC NHIỆM MÙ - BLIND WAR
programme.desc: Cựu đội trưởng SWAT Dong Gu bị mất thị lực do chấn thương trong một nhiệm vụ thất bại và anh buộc phải chịu trách nhiệm. Anh ta cố gắng vượt qua và thích nghi với tình hình ở công ty của con gái mình, cho đến khi kẻ thù của anh ta xuất hiện và khiến con gái anh ta gặp nguy hiểm. Dù bị mù nhưng Dong Gu vẫn phải chiến đấu để cứu con gái mình.

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: TRUY TÌM BÍ DANH SỐ 0 - THE COMEBACK
programme.desc: Chú Hứa là một đặc vụ đã nghỉ hưu, chủ một cửa hàng đồ cổ trên phố cổ. Một ngày nọ, khi con phố cũ bị Green Dragon Gang địa phương buộc phải phá bỏ, danh tính ẩn giấu của chú Hua vô tình bị tiết lộ và ông bị truy đuổi bởi một tổ chức bí ẩn do Ah Jie đứng đầu. Một cuộc đấu tay đôi chí mạng vừa mới bắt đầu!

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS

Hãy tham gia cùng các người mẫu nổi tiếng Indonesia Patricia và Chika khi họ khám phá những viên ngọc ẩn giấu và khung cảnh sôi động của thành phố, đắm mình trong sự tương phản đáng kinh ngạc và những rung cảm thời thượng.
